description: A short form that asks one question at a time, such as a visitor satisfaction survey. Supports single choice, multiple choice, text answers, required or skippable questions, and keyboard shortcuts.
tip: The navigation buttons hide themselves when they don't apply. Press A/B/C to pick an answer and Enter to continue.

parts.root: The form element. The shortcuts prop turns on letter or number shortcuts.
parts.progress: "Pertanyaan 1 dari 3" text and a progress bar.
parts.item: One question (fieldset); only the active one is shown.
parts.title: The question text (legend).
parts.choice: One choice shown as a card.
parts.choiceInput: Native radio or checkbox, in brand green.
parts.error: Message when the user continues without answering.
parts.navigation: Previous, Skip, Next and Submit buttons.

props.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts to pick an answer.
props.required: The question must be answered (cannot be skipped).
props.onSubmit: Called after the last question. Read the answers with FormData.
props.label: Progress text. Default: "Pertanyaan X dari Y".
